brief:
Build the staff's order screens on the round 7b SQL. Every function here is granted to `authenticated` and rechecks the caller's role inside, so the screens call them directly with `getSupabaseBrowserClient().rpc(...)` under the signed-in session; nothing in this round calls the `admin` Edge Function and nothing needs a TOTP step-up (refunds, rechecks and disputes are round 11b). The orchestrator's design decisions below are final; add no decoration, no icon, no new dependency.

1. Shared module `src/lib/admin-orders.ts`: the Arabic labels and the strict reply parsers, pure and unit-tested.
- Labels. Order status: pending_payment «بانتظار الدفع», expired «انتهت المهلة», cancelled «ملغى», paid «مدفوع», paid_needs_resolution «مدفوع: يحتاج حلًا», refunded «مُعاد». Filter: all «الكل», paid «المدفوعة», to_ship «للشحن», needs_resolution «تحتاج حلًا», pending «بانتظار الدفع», refunded «المُعادة», review «قيد المراجعة». Fulfilment type: digital «رقمي», physical «ورقي», signed «موقّع». Fulfilment state: preparing «قيد التجهيز», shipped «شُحن», delivered «سُلِّم». Return state: requested «مطلوب», approved «مقبول», rejected «مرفوض», received «مُستلَم», refunded «أُعيد المبلغ». Attempt status: creating «قيد الإنشاء», pending «بانتظار الدفع», uncertain «غير مؤكد», paid «مدفوع», review «قيد المراجعة», failed «رفضه المزوّد», expired «انتهى», cancelled «ملغى», abandoned «متروك». Review reason: AMOUNT_MISMATCH «مبلغ مختلف», CURRENCY_MISMATCH «عملة مختلفة», UNEXPECTED_STATUS «حالة غير متوقعة», SECOND_PAYMENT «دفعة ثانية على فاتورة مدفوعة», ORDER_ALREADY_PAID «الطلب مدفوع بدفعة أخرى», UNMAPPED_INVOICE «فاتورة غير مرتبطة بطلب». Refund status: submitting «قيد الإرسال», uncertain «غير مؤكد», succeeded «تم», failed «لم يتم»; source admin «من اللوحة», provider_dashboard «من لوحة Moyasar». Environment test → the badge «تجريبي» (live shows nothing). An unknown enum value is shown as its code (`dir="ltr"`), never an exception and never a blank.
- Parsers for `orders_list`, `order_detail` (the owner's reply has `disputes` and `audit`, the operations reply has neither key: both are valid), `orders_alerts`: every documented key with its type; money integers; ids UUID-shaped; dates ISO strings. A reply that fails the parser is a load failure (the screen says «تعذّر التحميل.» with «تحديث»), never a half-drawn order. Extra keys are ignored here (staff screens, not the buyer's).
- `normalizeOrderQuery(text)`: trimmed; an order number (the pattern the SQL accepts; read it in the migration) upper-cased; an email lower-cased by the same normalization `orders_list` applies (read it); anything else is invalid and the screen says «أدخل رقم طلب كاملًا أو بريدًا إلكترونيًا.» without calling the function (the SQL raises 22023 for it).

2. `/admin/orders` (`src/app/(admin)/admin/(shell)/orders/page.tsx`, a static shell around `src/components/admin/OrdersView.tsx`), owner and operations; an editor sees «لا تملك صلاحية الوصول» and no call is made.
- The alerts line from `orders_alerts()` at the top: «تحتاج حلًا: n · للشحن: n · دفعات قيد المراجعة: n», and for the owner only one more count, «تحتاج مطابقة: n» (the sum of uncertainRefunds, unverifiedAttempts, exhaustedEvents and externalRefunds; round 11b links it to the reconciliation screen). Low stock is not on this screen (the home has it).
- The filter as a row of buttons with `aria-pressed` (the seven filters, «الكل» first), the search as a labelled field «بحث برقم الطلب أو البريد» with a submit button «بحث» and «مسح» when a search is active. Search and filter combine as `orders_list(p_filter, p_query, p_before, p_limit: 50)`.
- The table (inside `.tableWrap`, so only the table scrolls at 360): order number (a link to the view, `dir="ltr"`), date (`formatRiyadh` of createdAt), status label, total (`formatMoney`), name, email (`dir="ltr"`), items, to ship, refunded (money, empty when 0), and the badges «تجريبي» (test) and «قيد المراجعة» (review). «المزيد» appends the next page with `p_before = next` while `next` is not null. «لا توجد طلبات.» when the first page is empty.
- The customer's orders: the customers list (generic `TableList`) gains one optional per-row link in the table config (`rowLink?: (row) => {href, label} | null`, used by the customers config only): «طلباته» to `/admin/orders#q=<encodeURIComponent(email)>`. The orders screen reads `#q=` once on mount, puts it in the search field, runs that search, and removes the fragment from the address bar with `history.replaceState` at once. An email never travels in a query string.

3. `/admin/orders/view?id=<uuid>` (`.../orders/view/page.tsx` around `src/components/admin/OrderView.tsx`, `useSearchParams` under Suspense like `TableForm`). A missing or non-UUID id, or `NOT_FOUND`, says «لم نجد هذا الطلب.» with a link back to the list. Sections, in this order, each with an `h2`:
- Header: the order number (`h1`), the status label, the «تجريبي» badge, created and paid times, the hold's end while `pending_payment`.
- «العميل والتوصيل»: name, email, phone (`dir="ltr"`), city and address (the contact is for fulfilment: no other use is offered).
- «العناصر»: per line the SKU (`dir="ltr"`), product and variant titles, type, quantity, unit price, discount, total, the dedication text for a signed line, «طلب مسبق: يُسلَّم في <date>» and the note for a preorder line, the refunded amount and «مُعاد بالكامل» when fullyRefunded. Then the totals: subtotal, discount (with the coupon code), shipping, total, refunded.
- «الدفع»: each attempt with its status label, amount, environment, the provider's invoice id and payment id (`dir="ltr"`, selectable, labelled «رقم الفاتورة لدى Moyasar» and «رقم الدفعة لدى Moyasar»), the provider's status and refunded total, captured, fee, source type and company, paid and fetched times, and the last error code. Review payments of the order under «دفعات قيد المراجعة»: reason label, amount, provider status, refunded, created, closed with its reason. The owner gets «إغلاق المراجعة» on an open one: a reason field (1 to 300 characters, one line, refused when it is the word `refunded`), then `review_close(p_payment, p_reason)`; `ALREADY_CLOSED` and `NOT_FOUND` have their own sentences.
- «الشحن» (physical and signed lines): each line's fulfilment state, carrier, tracking (`dir="ltr"`), dedication done, shipped and delivered times. Controls (owner and operations), on a `paid` order only: checkboxes for the lines (a fully refunded line still being prepared is shown but cannot be selected), then one of three actions on the selected lines: «تم الإهداء» (`p_state 'preparing'`, `p_dedication_done true`; offered only when a selected line is signed and not yet done), «تم الشحن» (needs «شركة الشحن» up to 80 characters and «رقم التتبع» up to 120, both trimmed and required), «تم التسليم». One call `fulfillment_update(p_order, p_item_ids, p_state, p_carrier, p_tracking, p_dedication_done)`. Replies: `changed: false` «لا تغيير.»; success «تم التحديث.» and the order is read again; `ORDER_NOT_PAID` «الطلب غير مدفوع، فلا يُشحن.», `INVALID_ITEMS` «اختر عناصر من هذا الطلب.», `BAD_TRANSITION` «لا تنتقل هذه العناصر إلى هذه الحالة.», `ITEM_REFUNDED` «عنصر مُعاد مبلغه بالكامل لا يُشحن.», `DEDICATION_NOT_DONE` «أكمل الإهداء قبل الشحن.», each followed by the titles of the lines in `itemIds`.
- «الملفات» (digital lines): granted or revoked (with the reason code), and whether a file is attached (its filename) or «بانتظار الملف».
- «الإرجاع»: each return with its state, items (titles and quantities), reason, staff note, restocked quantities, created time. On `requested`: «قبول» and «رفض» with an optional note (up to 500) → `return_decide(p_return, p_decision, p_note)`. On `approved`: «تم الاستلام» → `return_receive(p_return, p_restock)`; the owner also sees, per returned line that is not a preorder, a number field «يعود إلى المخزون» from 0 to the returned quantity (0 by default; the restock is the owner's word that the goods are sellable), operations see no restock fields and always send `[]`. Refusals `BAD_TRANSITION` (with the state), `INVALID_ITEMS`, `NOT_FOUND` have their sentences; the success shows the restocked lines «أُعيد إلى المخزون: <SKU> من <from> إلى <to>».
- The owner only, on `paid_needs_resolution`: «إكمال الطلب» with the sentence «يُخصم المخزون للعناصر غير المعادة، وتُمنح الملفات، ويُرسل إيصال.» and a second, explicit confirmation button «تأكيد إكمال الطلب» before `order_resolve(p_order)`; `STOCK_UNAVAILABLE` «المخزون لا يكفي لعنصر في هذا الطلب؛ عدّل المخزون أو أعد مبلغ العنصر أولًا.», `REFUND_IN_FLIGHT` «استرداد قيد المعالجة؛ أعد المحاولة بعد دقائق.», `NOT_RESOLVABLE` (with the status).
- The owner only: «النزاعات» (each row: kind, reference `dir="ltr"`, seq, amount, direction, date, decision, reason, resolution) and «السجل» (the audit rows: time, action code `dir="ltr"`, summary). Read-only here.
- The refunds of the order, read-only in this round: status label, amount, reason, source, created and succeeded times, error code (round 11b adds the refund form and the rechecks).
Every action: the button is disabled while its call is in flight (a second press sends nothing); one `role="status"` line and one `role="alert"` line per screen, both mounted before they are filled; after an action the focus goes to the line that reports it. A PostgREST error with code 42501 says «لا تملك صلاحية هذا الإجراء.»; any other error «تعذّر الحفظ. حاول مرة أخرى.»; nothing optimistic: the screen shows what the re-read order says.

4. The nav (`AdminShell`): «الطلبات» → `/admin/orders`, for owner and operations, right after «المتجر».

5. The home (`AdminHome`): a section «الطلبات» for owner and operations from `orders_alerts()`: «تحتاج حلًا: n», «للشحن: n», «دفعات قيد المراجعة: n», for the owner also «تحتاج مطابقة: n», then «مخزون منخفض» listing up to 10 of `lowStock` as «<title> (<SKU>): <stock> من حد <threshold>» and «و<n> غيرها» beyond 10; a link «فتح الطلبات». Loading and error states like the other sections; an editor's home makes no such call.

6. `scripts/check-export.mjs`: add `admin/orders.html` and `admin/orders/view.html` to REQUIRED.

7. Accessibility and layout at 360 and 1440: every control labelled, 44px targets, tables scroll inside `.tableWrap` (the page itself never scrolls sideways), ids and numbers readable, `dir="ltr"` only on ids, phone, email and codes. Admin pages are not money pages for the buyer, but add no reveal and no motion.

8. Tests.
- `tests/unit/admin-orders.test.ts` (new): every label table including an unknown value; each parser accepts the round 7b SHAPE (owner and operations variants of `order_detail`) and refuses a missing key or a wrong type; `normalizeOrderQuery` for a number, a mixed-case email, spaces, and invalid text.
- `tests/e2e/orders-admin.spec.ts` (new), on the real local stack with real sign-in (the store-admin and owner-operations way), each test at 360 and 1440. Seed through the service role (`commerceHarness`, or SQL the way order-operations.test.ts does it, with the pepper from `localEnv()`; never open a .env file yourself): a paid order with a physical, a signed and a digital line; a `paid_needs_resolution` order; a pending order; a test-environment order; an operations member and an editor. Prove, without mocks: the list with each filter that has data, the search by number and by email (typed in another case), the view's sections, the signed line refused before its dedication then shipped after «تم الإهداء», shipping without a carrier refused by the form, delivery, a return filed through `return_request_create` then accepted and received with a restock by the owner (the stock rises by the restocked quantity), the operations member's view without the owner's parts and without restock fields, the editor refused, the resolution after the stock is raised, the customer's orders link (the search filled, the fragment gone), a double press sending one request, the home's counts. Mock (`page.route` on `/rest/v1/rpc/...`) only what the seed cannot make cheaply: «المزيد» with a `next`, an open review payment and its closing, the disputes and audit lists, a load failure. Save screenshots of the list, the view and the home at both widths (`tests/e2e/shots.ts`) and assert no horizontal page overflow. Clean up what the spec created (the harness's `stop()`).
- Run `tests/e2e/store-admin.spec.ts` and `tests/e2e/owner-operations.spec.ts` in full: the nav, the home and the generic list changed.

Run the dev server only through Playwright's own webServer. Before any e2e run check that at least 10 GB of memory is free; if not, stop leftover headless Chrome processes, and if it is still short report it and skip the e2e run. Copy `next-env.d.ts` aside before an e2e run or a build and restore it after; if `pnpm typecheck` then fails with TS1128 in `.next/e2e`, remove `.next/e2e`.

Never open, read or print a .env file (the repository's, `.env.local` or `supabase/functions/.env`), not even to derive a test value; the test helpers already load what a test needs.
checks: pnpm build, then pnpm check:export and pnpm check:budgets
pnpm exec playwright test tests/e2e/orders-admin.spec.ts tests/e2e/store-admin.spec.ts tests/e2e/owner-operations.spec.ts (memory check first; base URL http://localhost:3000)
auditFocus: Roles: can an operations member see or call anything owner-only (resolve, review close, restock, disputes, audit, the reconciliation count), can an editor reach any order data, and does every screen rely on the SQL's own recheck rather than hiding alone. The wire: every RPC's argument names and types against the SQL signatures in 20261002145000_order_operations.sql, and every parser against the SQL's real reply (the e2e reads real replies, not only mocks). Money: integer halalas end to end, `formatMoney` only, no float arithmetic. Privacy: no email or order data in a query string or a log; the customer link's fragment removed at once. The actions: offered only when the state allows them, a double press sends one call, nothing optimistic, every refusal code worded, the restock bounded and owner-only, the resolution behind an explicit confirmation. Accessibility at 360 and 1440: labels, status and alert regions mounted first, focus after an action, tables scrolling inside their wrapper. The tests: real data where it is cheap, both widths, the owner, operations and editor paths.
